 """Tiny slug helper."""
 
+import re
+import string
+import unicodedata
 
-def slugify(text):
-    """Lowercase ``text`` and replace spaces with hyphens."""
-    return text.lower().replace(" ", "-")
+
+def slugify(text: str) -> str:
+    """Lowercase ``text``, strip punctuation, collapse repeated separators, and trim hyphens."""
+    text = text.lower()
+    # Strip punctuation (excluding '-' which serves as a separator)
+    text = "".join(
+        ch for ch in text
+        if ch == "-" or (ch not in string.punctuation and not unicodedata.category(ch).startswith("P"))
+    )
+    # Collapse repeated separators into a single '-'
+    text = re.sub(r"[-\s]+", "-", text)
+    # Trim leading and trailing '-'
+    return text.strip("-")

+def test_slugify_punctuation():
+    assert slugify("Hello, World!") == "hello-world"
+    assert slugify("What?! No way...") == "what-no-way"
+    assert slugify("foo: bar; baz.") == "foo-bar-baz"
+    assert slugify("It's a test #1") == "its-a-test-1"
+
+
+def test_slugify_repeated_spaces():
+    assert slugify("Hello   World") == "hello-world"
+    assert slugify("   multiple   spaces   here   ") == "multiple-spaces-here"
+    assert slugify("hello - world") == "hello-world"
+    assert slugify("hello---world") == "hello-world"
+
+
+def test_slugify_empty_input():
+    assert slugify("") == ""
+    assert slugify("   ") == ""
+    assert slugify("---") == ""
+    assert slugify("!@#$%^&*()") == ""
